source.material: Three adult friends sit at a café table. One describes discovering a funny typo on a presentation slide just before a meeting, while another asks how the audience reacted. The third friend stays with the gathering and nobody enters, leaves, or changes seats.

source_abstraction.premise: A small group gathers at a café table as one person recounts an embarrassing workplace mishap to their engaged companions.
source_abstraction.interaction_arc: A speaker begins sharing a lighthearted mishap from their day, prompting an inquisitive follow-up question from a listener before the speaker delivers the humorous outcome to the attentive group.

shots.beat: A begins recounting an awkward office mishap, raising both hands to animate the story, while B smiles across the table and C holds a coffee cup with an attentive grin.

shots.content: In a quiet café seating area, a rectangular wooden table runs parallel to a window, with a tall floor plant standing directly behind the table's plant-side short end, the café counter located beyond the opposite short end, and an open aisle along the side opposite the window. Seated in the window-side seat nearest the tall floor plant is a person in a mustard-yellow knit sweater with hair styled in a high messy bun, who begins recounting an awkward office mishap by raising both hands to animate the story. Across from the open aisle space, in the window-side seat nearest the café counter, a companion in an emerald-green button-up shirt wearing round tortoiseshell glasses smiles attentively. Meanwhile, an individual in a navy-blue fleece zip jacket with a silver pixie haircut sits at the short-end seat directly in front of the tall floor plant, holding a coffee cup with an attentive grin.

The person in the emerald-green button-up shirt wearing round tortoiseshell glasses leans in curiously to ask a clarifying question, prompting the companion in the mustard-yellow knit sweater with her hair in a high messy bun to shake her head and chuckle in self-deprecating amusement.

The storyteller in the mustard-yellow knit sweater with a high messy bun delivers the punchline with an expressive sigh and an open-palmed shrug, causing the listener in the emerald-green button-up shirt wearing round tortoiseshell glasses to burst into soft laughter.
